# Write the LinkedIn article for this starter

Inputs: `ARTICLE.md` (skeleton with the problem line and the ARAG section already written), `README.md`, `BRIEF.md`, and the evidence from the build chats.

Rules:
- Keep the opening quote exactly as written. It is the hook and the post's first line.
- About 700 words. Short paragraphs. Australian English. No em dashes (use " - "). No banned words: delve, leverage, unlock, seamless, game-changing. No hedging, no symmetrical triads, no "in today's world".
- Write for the person who pays for the problem, not the developer. Endpoint names stay out; the How this works section is four plain lines.
- Only claim what the evidence shows. No accuracy percentages, no made-up numbers. "Half a day" is allowed only if it was.
- End with the three "Where to take it next" items, the repo and live links, and one line: tag the person who has this problem.
- Also produce the 3-line post text (hook, one sentence on what it does, the ask) and a 45-second video shot list (5 shots).

Output: the full `ARTICLE.md` body, then the post text, then the shot list.
